description: If a finite partial isomorphism exists between structures \(M,N\), every closed atomic formula has the same truth value in both structures.
signature:

  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BackAndForth.FinitePartialIso L M N) (φ : L.Formula (Fin 0))
  (hφ : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsAtomic φ) : φ.Realize Fin.elim0 ↔ φ.Realize Fin.elim0
